content.text:
Source a658b389aa0b30f6c0962fda6245673393bcc0ff passed all five public gates: 497 explicit reports (494 standard, 3 axiom-free), 136 original resource probes, 92 independent imports and 98701 audited declarations. No sorryAx or nonstandard axiom passed.

The actual eager worker preserves resources, UnionNormal and NoneBucketsEmpty at the ORIGINAL runtime budgets. The whole None-bucket theorem is now proved at its original 739feab7 header; every emitted/retained failure cache is covered. Complete/stopped native endpoints carry no enum cache. The original stopped endpoint resource conjunct remains True.

Accepted-source current rendering now derives Packet, normality, growth and None-bucket facts from the SAME actual run. With the explicit original-U boundary-atom condition, actual rendering success and returned-residual Boolean checks, it constructs ONE assignment satisfying the CURRENT before/after states, identifies the rendered term and completes every actual rootPartial read. OnlyOriginalUPending restricts boundary atoms, NOT domain handle identity. Fresh ordinary/union handles do not refute it. Whole-worker Profile closure is still missing.

A separate actual eager parked-step theorem constructs ONE finite assignment restoring EVERY occurrence of ONE removed raw arrow bucket, preserving old/current UF equations and native pending-domain membership at the same fuels. Its past resource/heap/OnlyU/None facts and raw paths [1] or [2] remain explicit. Current guards are conditional under THAT assignment. This is not the full original source-run reachability proof. The rendering and removed-bucket assignments are SEPARATE existential witnesses; they cannot be combined without a compatibility theorem.

New warm provenance derives actual issued-domain enter origins and AuthenticEntryAt. A returned cell is retained from actual call entry OR has a local actual producing query; no old enter/finish/ownership receipt is supplied. Both old owner files are byte-exact prefixes. This structural split does not establish inherited C/M semantic meanings. Keep the full observed source history fixed, including later qualifying U/P entries; do not weaken to cold histories or earlier qualifiers.

The main gap remains one compatible finite assignment for ALL removed/parked obligations on ONE actual branch plus current guards and the SAME original accepted root. Actual warm semantic C/M history and whole-worker pending Profile closure remain prerequisites. Independent bucket models and a path DAG do not prove compatibility; the earlier congruence-cycle caution remains only a logical caution, not an actual-source defect. Completeness/depth/LPO/stream/count/weight/rank/host-bounds and compiled Haskell correspondence retain their separate scope. No Haskell change or fix is claimed.
